judgment.observations: The reconstruction captures the bunk-room layout, timber framing, central cupboard and right-side fireplace, but differs substantially in detail. The view is more level, with less ceiling visible and a broader, more frontal presentation of the left bunks. The cupboard is narrower and its doors, compartments and contents are simplified. The fireplace loses the reference’s rounded stone arch and recessed, irregular brickwork, becoming a rectangular block-filled opening; the nearby black container is missing. The cropped right bunk is present but its framing and occlusion differ. Bed feet visibly meet the floor, though contact shadows are less distinct. Floorboards are finer, more uniform and less worn; walls, bedding, wood and metal lack the reference’s texture and tonal variation. Heavy render noise and flatter lighting further reduce similarity.
judgment.uncertain_3d_hypotheses: The left bunk arrangement appears more compressed and aligned, and the fireplace appears shallower, but these impressions could result from camera placement, projection, lighting or occlusion. Exact bed spacing, hidden supports and fireplace depth cannot be established from these images.
